villagechatter.configuration.title: Village Chatter
villagechatter.greeting.generic.2: Another adventurer? We get a lot of you lot these days.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.3: Hmm. You look like you've been sleeping in a hole.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.4: Good to see a friendly face. Mostly friendly. Is that blood?
villagechatter.greeting.generic.5: Ah. You again. Or someone who looks exactly like you.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.6: Hrm-hm. What can I do for you?
villagechatter.greeting.generic.7: If you're here about the missing bread, I know nothing.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.8: Quiet day. I like quiet days.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.9: Stay a while. Not too long. But a while.
villagechatter.greeting.night.0: Out this late? The dead walk at night, you know.
villagechatter.greeting.night.1: Hrmm... shouldn't you be indoors? I should be indoors.
villagechatter.greeting.night.2: Keep your voice down. The zombies have ears. Sort of.
villagechatter.greeting.rain.0: Miserable weather. Good for the crops, bad for my knees.
villagechatter.greeting.rain.1: Rain again. At least the fires stay out.
villagechatter.greeting.rain.2: You're dripping on my doorstep, friend.
villagechatter.greeting.hero.0: It's you! The one who drove off the raiders! Hrmm-hrm!
villagechatter.greeting.hero.1: Hero! Come, come, the whole village is talking about you.
villagechatter.greeting.hero.2: For you? I'd give my best prices. Almost.
villagechatter.greeting.hero.3: What did I do to deserve this honor?
villagechatter.greeting.hero.4: They'll sing about you at the well tonight. Badly, but they'll sing.
villagechatter.greeting.hero.5: You again! Sit, sit. Tell me everything.
villagechatter.greeting.hero.6: The kids play at being you, you know. Mostly the yelling part.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.hurt.0: You look half-dead. Get yourself patched up.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.hurt.1: Hurt? Rest inside the walls a while.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.hurt.2: Whoever did that to you, point me at them.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.hurt.4: Go see the cleric. That's an order.
villagechatter.greeting.hurt.1: You're bleeding on my doorstep. Sit, sit.
villagechatter.greeting.hurt.2: Oh my. Should you even be standing?
villagechatter.greeting.hurt.3: Whatever you fought, I hope it looks worse.
villagechatter.greeting.hurt.4: You look terrible. Eat something, please.
villagechatter.greeting.hurt.5: Easy now. Go see the cleric before you fall over.
villagechatter.greeting.grumpy.1: I remember what you did. Make it quick.
villagechatter.greeting.grumpy.2: Keep your hands where I can see them.
villagechatter.greeting.profession.minec: No work for me yet. If you see a free workstation, send it my way.
I'm between jobs. Have been for a while.
Hrmm? Hm. Hrrmmm. Hm!
I'm very busy doing nothing. Come back later.
Need protecting? I've got plates for every part of you.
That armor's seen better days. So have I.
Fresh meat today! Well. Fresh-ish.
Don't ask where the pork chops come from.
Lost? Everyone's lost until they buy a map.
I've charted every hill from here to the sea. Most of them.
Bless you, wanderer. Got any rotten flesh?
The stars speak to me. Mostly they say 'buy redstone'.
Careful where you step, those are my carrots.
Good soil this year. The bees have been busy.
Caught a pufferfish this morning. Nearly died. Good day.
Shh. You'll scare the fish.
Arrows, bows, feathers. Mostly feathers.
You look like someone who shoots first.
Smell that? That's quality leather. Probably.
Need a saddle? Boots? A nice hat?
Shh! This is a library. Well, a lectern. Shh anyway.
I have books on everything. Even on books.
Solid stone, solid prices.
Every wall in this village? Mine. Except the crooked one.
The sheep and I were just discussing you.
Wool in every color. Even the ugly ones.
Broke your pickaxe again, didn't you?
A good tool is a happy tool. I'm a happy tool. Wait.
Looking for something sharp?
My blades never dull. Your enemies, however...
villagechatter.greeting.entity.minecraft: Ah, a customer! I come from very far away. Very far. Buy something.
Don't mind the llamas. They spit, but only at people they dislike.
I have wares, if you have coin. Emeralds. Same thing.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.1: I used to be an adventurer like you. Then I got a nice pension.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.2: Keep the peace and we'll get along fine.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.0: I saw a sheep today. It was white. Very exciting.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.1: They say the iron golem has feelings. I don't believe it.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.2: Someone keeps taking the hay bales. I have my suspicions.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.3: The bell rang last night and nobody knows why. Hrmm.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.4: My cousin moved to a desert village. Never heard from him again. Well, once.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.5: Have you tried the bread here? Don't.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.6: There's a witch hut out in the swamp, they say. I don't go to the swamp.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.7: A traveler came through with twelve llamas. TWELVE.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.8: Nothing much happens here. That's how we like it.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.9: Pillagers have been sighted on the roads. Keep your wits about you.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.10: I dug a hole once. Found a creeper. Never dug again.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.11: If you find any emeralds lying around, they're probably mine.
villagechatter.smalltalk.night.0: Something was scratching at my door last night. I didn't open it.
villagechatter.smalltalk.rain.0: When it storms the creepers get... sparkly. Stay away from sparkly creepers.
villagechatter.smalltalk.grumpy.1: The only news is that you're still here.
villagechatter.smalltalk.profession.mine: The bees have been buzzing around the flower fields again. Good for the harvest.
There are ruins out past the hills. I haven't drawn them yet. Too scary.
Something big lives in the deep water. I've seen the bubbles.
I read that there's a stronghold under every... no, I forget the rest.
Business is good when the raiders are about. Not that I want raiders.
The End is not a metaphor, traveler. It is a place.
Hrm. Hrrrm. Hmmmmm. Hm!
villagechatter.smalltalk.entity.minecraf: I've seen jungles, deserts, mountains. This village is... a village.
Never trust a llama with a blue carpet. Long story.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.0: Quiet shift. I like quiet shifts.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.1: Saw a pillager scout on the ridge yesterday. He ran when he saw me.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.2: No loitering by the bell. Village rules.
villagechatter.greeting.danger.1: Did you hear that? Something's out there.
villagechatter.greeting.danger.2: Keep your voice down. Monsters about.
villagechatter.greeting.danger.3: I don't like this. I don't like this at all.
villagechatter.greeting.victory.0: Did you see that? I... I think I won!
villagechatter.smalltalk.danger.0: I'm not leaving my house until morning.
villagechatter.smalltalk.danger.1: My cousin went out after dark once. Once.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.combat.2: To arms! Help me drive them back!
villagechatter.greeting.guard.danger.0: Be careful, there are enemies nearby.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.danger.1: Eyes open. Something's lurking out there.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.danger.2: I can smell rot on the wind. Zombies.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.danger.3: Stay sharp, traveler. We're not alone.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.victory.0: Got one! Did you see that?
villagechatter.greeting.guard.victory.1: I just took care of a zombie. You're welcome.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.victory.2: Another one down. The village sleeps safe tonight.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.night.2: Long night ahead. Long, long night.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.night.3: Halt! Oh, it's you. Carry on.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.danger.0: Monsters gather when the light fails. Stay near the torches.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.danger.1: Something's been testing the walls every night this week.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.victory.0: I've lost count of how many I've cut down this week. Seven? Eight?
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.victory.1: That one had a pumpkin on its head. Why do they do that?
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.night.0: The night shift is quiet. Too quiet, some say. I say it's just quiet.
villagechatter.farewell.hero.1: The village is in your debt!
villagechatter.farewell.guard.victory.0: Tell the others what you saw!
villagechatter.farewell.guard.night.1: Quiet night. Let's keep it that way.
villagechatter.farewell.entity.minecraft: May the roads be kind to you!
The llamas will miss you. Probably.
villagechatter.option.give_iron: "Hold still, buddy. Let me patch that crack."
villagechatter.option.quiet: You don't talk much, do you?
villagechatter.option.dist_loose: Roam a bit. Keep to my flank.
villagechatter.option.gohome: It's not safe here. Go home.
villagechatter.option.comeback: Wait, I changed my mind. Come back!
villagechatter.greeting.baby.0: Hi! Hi! Are you an adventurer?
villagechatter.greeting.baby.2: Mom says I can't talk to strangers. Are you a stranger?
villagechatter.greeting.baby.3: Whoa, is that a real sword?
villagechatter.greeting.baby.4: I found a cool rock today! Wanna see? ...I lost it.
villagechatter.greeting.baby.6: Are you here to fight the monsters? I'm gonna help!
villagechatter.greeting.baby.danger.0: I'm scared... there's something out there!
villagechatter.greeting.baby.danger.1: Shh! I'm hiding from the monster!
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.0: I'm gonna be a librarian when I grow up. Or a cat.
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.1: We're playing hide and seek. Don't tell anyone where I am!
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.2: Did you know chickens can't fly? I tried to help one.
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.3: My friend says golems eat iron. Is that true?
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.4: I'm not supposed to go past the fence. I went past the fence once.
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.5: When I grow up I'm gonna fight a zombie!
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.6: The iron golem let me sit on his foot today!
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.7: I can hold my breath for, like, a hundred seconds.
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.danger.0: I'm not scared. I'm just... hiding. Strategically.
villagechatter.greeting.entity.minecraft: *The golem looks down at you and rumbles.*
*A low, grinding hum. The golem tilts its head.*
*The golem's eyes follow you, patient as stone.*
*It creaks, shifting its weight. That might be a hello.*
*The golem pauses its patrol and regards you.*
*The golem's gaze drops to the poppy you're carrying. It goes very still.*
*The golem rumbles softly. It's noticed the poppy.*
*Its eyes flick to your pack, then back to you. It knows you have a flower.*
*The golem's cracked plating catches the light. It eyes the iron in your pack.*
*A dented golem. It glances at your iron, then back at you.*
*The golem's head turns toward the dark. It's already watching something.*
*The golem doesn't even look at you. It's busy.*
villagechatter.reply.howareyou.entity.mi: *It rumbles, long and low. You decide that means 'fine'.*
*The golem pats your head. Gently. Mostly.*
*A slow creak, then a contented hum.*
villagechatter.reply.quiet.entity.minecr: *The golem stares at you for a long moment, then rumbles once.*
*It shrugs. You didn't know golems could shrug.*
villagechatter.reply.give_poppy.entity.m: *The golem takes the poppy with surprising care and holds it out, proud.*
*Its eyes brighten. The poppy disappears into its huge hand. The village will hear about this.*
*The golem rumbles, softer than you've ever heard it, and holds the flower up to the light.*
villagechatter.reply.give_iron.entity.mi: *Metal grinds into place. The golem flexes its arm and rumbles, satisfied.*
*Patched up. The golem gives you a slow, grateful nod.*
villagechatter.reply.nothing.entity.mine: *You pat your pockets. Nothing. The golem waits politely.*
villagechatter.farewell.entity.minecraft: *It raises one huge hand. Then goes back to guarding.*

villagechatter.reply.trick.entity.minecr: %s shows off! Who's a good dog?
%s performs with great seriousness, then wags.
%s considers it... and actually does it.
%s does something. You choose to call it a trick.
villagechatter.reply.gohome.entity.minec: %s whines softly, then turns and trots off toward home.
%s gives you a long look, then heads home.
%s flicks their tail and saunters off. Home it is.
%s chirps sadly and flutters off toward home.
villagechatter.reply.nohome.pet.0: %s looks around, confused. You haven't slept in a bed for them to go home to.
villagechatter.reply.comeback.entity.min: %s spins around and races back to you!
%s pretends that was their idea and comes back.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.10: Hey, you. You're finally awake. ...Sorry, I say that to everyone.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.11: Do you get to the woodland mansion very often? Oh, what am I saying, of course you don't.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.12: Hrmm. Another one who thinks they're the hero of this story.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.13: Welcome to the village! Population: more than yesterday, fewer than the last raid.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.14: You're the one who keeps opening our chests, aren't you? Don't answer. I know.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.15: Ah, a customer! No, wait, you're just standing there. Hrmm.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.16: Wipe your boots. Some of us just swept the dirt path.
villagechatter.greeting.generic.17: Oh good, an adventurer. Something must be on fire.
villagechatter.greeting.grumpy.3: Stop right there, criminal scum! ...Fine, keep walking. But I'm watching you.
villagechatter.greeting.grumpy.4: The golem knows what you did. The golem remembers.
villagechatter.greeting.grumpy.5: Oh. It's you. Lovely. Wonderful. Go away.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.5: Citizen. Keep your weapon sheathed and your torches lit.
villagechatter.greeting.baby.7: Hiii! Are you an adventurer? Do you have a sword? Can I hold it?
villagechatter.greeting.baby.8: My dad says not to talk to strangers. Are you strange?
villagechatter.greeting.baby.9: Whoa, your armor is so cool. Did you fight a dragon?
villagechatter.greeting.entity.minecraft: Got some rare things on sale, stranger!
Don't mind the llamas. They spit, but they spit with love.
villagechatter.greeting.profession.minec: Morning! Or afternoon. Out here every hour looks the same: wheat-colored.
Hungry? Bread's cheap. Starving? Bread's slightly less cheap.
Mind the farmland. Jumping on it is a crime here. A real one.
Pumpkins are coming in nicely. Don't ask why one of them has a face.
You look like someone who's eaten a raw potato. Brave.
Fresh beetroot! Nobody wants it, but it's fresh.
Ahoy! That's a fishing word. I don't actually own a boat.
Smell that? That's the sea. Or me. Hard to tell anymore.
Today's catch: two cod, a boot and a saddle. Somebody's having a bad day.
You've got the patience of a fisherman. Or the boredom of one.
You seek my potions? My potions are too strong for you, traveler.
Ah, a pilgrim. Or a customer. In this economy I welcome both.
Kneel. No? Fine. Standing is also acceptable.
The redstone hums today. That's either a blessing or a broken repeater.
Stay a while and listen! ...No? Most people don't.
Welcome! Please don't reshelve anything. I have a system.
You look like someone who enchants things recklessly. I respect that.
Quiet, please. The books are sleeping.
Not all who wander are lost. You, however, look lost.
Here be dragons. Well, one dragon. In the End. Very far.
Found somewhere I haven't drawn yet? Tell me. Don't tell the other cartographers.
It's dangerous to go alone! Take this. For twelve emeralds.
Sword, axe, or please-don't-hit-me money?
Swing it, don't stab it. Unless you're stabbing. Then stab.
Diamonds? In this economy?
Chainmail's coming back into fashion, I'll have you know.
You should see the other guy. Actually, you probably shouldn't.
Never dig straight down. My cousin did. We don't talk about him.
Pickaxe, shovel, hoe. A tool for every hole.
Unbreaking Three. That's all I'm going to say.
Dirt houses are a cry for help, you know.
Stone bricks: the backbone of civilization.
Measure twice, mine once.
Every color of wool! Except plaid. Never plaid.
Count the sheep with me. One... two... I've lost track.
Today's special: mystery meat. The mystery is which animal.
Hungry? Come back hungrier. I'll be here.
I used to be an adventurer like you. Then I started selling the arrows instead.
Feathers! I need feathers! You have feathers? No? Hrmm.
Need a saddle? You look like a horse person.
Leather: it's just cow, but fancy.
I'm not superstitious. But I am a little stitious.
The cake is a lie. I checked.
Did you know I can walk? Watch. ...Wasn't that great?
Got a workstation to spare? A barrel? A cauldron? Anything?
I could be a librarian. Or a farmer. Look, I'm flexible.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.12: There's a strange cardboard box with legs sneaking around the fields at night. When you look at it, it stops moving.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.13: They say Herobrine was removed. Again. Every single update.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.14: Someone built a nether portal behind the church. The cleric is not pleased.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.15: Never bring a lava bucket indoors. I learned that from a neighbor. A former neighbor.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.16: Someone keeps punching trees with their bare hands. Just punching. For hours.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.17: A traveler tried to sleep in my bed, said there were monsters nearby, and left. Rude.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.18: The enderman stared at me for an hour. I stared back. I think I won.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.19: I'm told the moon is a cube. Like everything else, really.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.20: Do you know the way to the stronghold? Me neither. Throw an eye, I'm told.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.21: Somebody keeps building dirt pillars on the plains and then just leaving them.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.22: A Steve came by. Or an Alex. You adventurers all look alike to me.
villagechatter.smalltalk.generic.23: The witch out by the swamp sells potions too. Hers don't come with a warranty.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.3: I used to be an adventurer like you. Then I took an arrow in the knee.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.4: Stop right there, criminal scum! ...Sorry. Practicing.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.5: My cousin guards a desert village. Says the husks are worse. He says a lot of things.
villagechatter.smalltalk.guard.6: If you see a cardboard box moving, tell me. Don't open it. Just tell me.
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.8: Are you Steve? My mom says Steve isn't real.
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.9: I saw a creeper once! It went tsssss and then I ran!
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.10: Mom says if I'm good I can have a pet axolotl.
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.11: Can you make a nether portal? Please? I won't tell anyone.
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.12: I'm gonna be the hero of the village when I grow up!
villagechatter.smalltalk.baby.13: I named a chicken Nugget. Mom didn't like that.
villagechatter.smalltalk.entity.minecraf: I sell what I find. Don't ask where I find it.
The llamas spit at everyone. Don't take it personally.
villagechatter.smalltalk.profession.mine: Something keeps trampling the crops at night. Big footprints. Square ones.
That cardboard box was in my wheat again last night. It's getting bolder.
The crows here are bold. One looked me in the eye and took a seed. I respect it.
Grandpa said never plant beetroot on a full moon. He never said why. He just stared.
A rabbit got into the carrots again. I've started calling him the Beast. He's earned it.
Thirty years I've grown wheat. Thirty. The bread still tastes like bread.
We're gonna need a bigger boat. Kidding. We don't have a boat at all.
I fished up an enchanted bow once. Threw it back. Felt wrong to keep it.
Guardians in the deep ocean. One eye, all spikes, terrible manners.
The drowned took my best rod. If you see a zombie fishing, that's mine.
Tell the axolotls I said hello. They know what they did.
A knight came by demanding my strongest potions. I told him he couldn't handle them. He couldn't.
Praise the sun, I always say. The zombies certainly don't.
Some say the Ender Dragon dreams. I say it's just very grumpy.
I read the bones this morning. They said 'skeleton'. Very literal, bones.
Bring me lapis and I'll tell your future. It involves less lapis.
I once traded a Mending book for a stick. One stick. I think about it every night.
There's a book in the woodland mansion about the family who lived there. It's mostly screaming.
Every library needs a ladder. Mine has one. It goes nowhere.
Knowledge is power. Power is redstone. Redstone is cheap. So knowledge is... hm, that went wrong.
If you read the same book three times, it starts reading you back. Hrmm.
I drew a map of a woodland mansion once. Then a map of me running away from it.
The world just keeps going. I walked for days. It just keeps going.
My maps are accurate to the block. The world isn't. It changes when nobody's looking.
One does not simply walk into the Nether. You need obsidian. And a flint and steel. And courage.
Netherite is the future, they say. The future is very expensive.
A man asked for a sword that never misses. I gave him an axe. Close enough.
I sharpen everything. Swords. Axes. My wit. Mostly swords.
Raiders came last spring. Business was excellent. Morale, less so.
Iron golems don't need armor. I've asked. Very politely.
Someone returned a helmet with a bite mark in it. A zombie, I hope.
Leather armor is for people who care more about fashion than living.
Every dent tells a story. That one says 'skeleton'.
Someone dug right under my house. I heard 'diamonds!' and then lava noises.
A tool that never breaks? That's called taking care of it.
The best ore is always one block past where you stopped digging.
I made a golden pickaxe once. It broke if you looked at it funny.
Somebody built a whole dirt house near here. I left a stone brick on the doorstep. As a hint.
Terracotta isn't a phase. It's a lifestyle.
I once built a tower up to the clouds. The clouds didn't care.
Every wall needs a corner. Most need four.
If you ever hear an evoker yell 'wololo' at a blue sheep, run. Trust me.
Somebody named a sheep jeb_ and now it won't stop changing color.
Sheep are smarter than they look. They'd have to be.
A wolf ate three of my sheep last winter. I've forgiven him. Mostly.
Someone named a pig Dinnerbone. Now it walks upside down. I'm not selling that one.
Rabbit stew is a lot of work. A LOT of work.
Raw chicken? Never. Ask the zombies how that went.
Skeletons use my arrows against me. No respect.
A lad named Leeroy took my best bow into a raid. Brave lad. Short story.
Crossbows are fine, if you enjoy waiting.
Someone asked for leather pants with a hood. I said no. They asked again.
Horses love me. Cows, understandably, less so.
Dye your armor! Nobody looks good in brown.
Every night I sleep in a different bed. Everyone hates it.
I asked the librarian for a job. He gave me a book. I'm still holding it.
I talked to a chicken today. It didn't answer. Rude.
If you see Herobrine, say hi. He never says hi back.
Every day I walk past the job sites. They just... look at me.
Mother wanted me to be a cleric. I wanted to be a cleric too. And yet.
villagechatter.tired.generic.0: You ask a lot of questions, don't you?
villagechatter.tired.generic.1: Hrmm. Don't you have a dragon to slay or something?
villagechatter.tired.generic.2: I've told you everything I know. Twice.
villagechatter.tired.generic.4: Is this an interrogation? Should I call the golem?
villagechatter.tired.generic.5: Go bother the librarian. He loves questions.
villagechatter.tired.generic.6: I need to go stare at a wall for a while. Villager things.
villagechatter.tired.baby.0: Mom says I'm not allowed to talk this much.
villagechatter.tired.baby.1: You're like my little sister. Why why why why!
villagechatter.tired.baby.2: I'm bored of questions. Wanna play tag instead?

villagechatter.configuration.piglinSeekF: Share of a piglin's time left when it walks to Nether ground to refresh (0.25 = the last quarter).
villagechatter.configuration.piglinSeekR: How far (blocks) a piglin looks for Nether ground when its time runs low.
villagechatter.option.sabotage_ask.1: Anything I can do for you?
villagechatter.option.sabotage_done.0: That job you gave me? Taken care of.
villagechatter.sabotage.ready: Job done. Report back to the %s.
villagechatter.sabotage.village.cull.pil: Those raiders keep watching our fields from the hills. Thin them out. %s of them should make the rest think twice.
If you can handle a crossbow or two... take down %s pillagers. We'd all sleep better.
villagechatter.sabotage.village.cull.pig: Traders say those pig-men in the Nether have been raiding caravans. Put down %s of them, would you?
My cousin lost a whole cart to piglins. Settle it for us: %s of them.
villagechatter.sabotage.village.loot.pil: That outpost on the ridge is full of things they took from us. Get into one of their chests and take something back.
Rob the robbers. Any chest in one of their outposts. Whatever's in there was ours to begin with.
villagechatter.sabotage.village.loot.pig: Piglins hoard gold in those black-stone fortresses. Lift something from a bastion chest. They'll never miss it.
Fair's fair: they take from us, we take from them. Bring something out of a bastion chest.
villagechatter.sabotage.village.accept.0: Thank you. Come back and tell me when it's done.
villagechatter.sabotage.village.accept.1: Be careful out there. And come find one of us after.
Oh. I see. I thought you were different.
Right. Well, someone else will have to, then.
villagechatter.sabotage.village.done.0: You did it? The whole village will hear of this.
villagechatter.sabotage.village.done.1: That's one less worry for us. Thank you, truly.
villagechatter.sabotage.pillager.cull.vi: Their tin giant keeps getting in our way. Break it. %s of them, and you'll have earned a drink.
Those villagers think their golems make them safe. Prove them wrong. %s.
villagechatter.sabotage.pillager.cull.pi: The pigs think the Nether's theirs. Gut %s of them and bring me the story.
Piglins. Filthy, greedy, loud. Kill %s and we'll call you one of us.
villagechatter.sabotage.pillager.loot.vi: Walk into one of their villages and empty a chest. If they catch you, that's your problem.
Their houses are full of things they don't deserve. Take something. Anything.
villagechatter.sabotage.pillager.loot.pi: There's gold in those bastions. Crack a chest. Keep what you want, just make the pigs squeal.
Rob a bastion chest. I want to hear the pigs screaming about it for weeks.
Good. Don't make me come looking for you.
Get it done and come back. Then we'll talk.
villagechatter.sabotage.pillager.decline: Then get out of my sight before I change my mind about you.
villagechatter.sabotage.pillager.done.0: Ha! You've got some blood on your blade after all.
villagechatter.sabotage.pillager.done.1: Well done. The others will hear you're one to count on.
villagechatter.sabotage.piglin.cull.vill: §o*snort*§r The iron ones keep chasing us off. Smash %s. Then we talk gold.
Villager guardians. Big. Annoying. Break %s of them. §o*grunt*§r
villagechatter.sabotage.piglin.cull.pill: The crossbow men shoot at us. §o*oink*§r Kill %s of them.
Grey-skins with crossbows. Hate them. %s of them, dead. Yes?
villagechatter.sabotage.piglin.loot.vill: Villagers keep shiny things in boxes. §o*snort*§r Take something from one. For us.
Go to a village. Open a box. Take. §o*grunt*§r Simple.
villagechatter.sabotage.piglin.loot.pill: The crossbow men have a tower full of stolen things. Steal from them. §o*oink*§r
Rob the grey-skins' tower. Any box. They rob everyone else.
villagechatter.sabotage.piglin.decline.1: Hmph. Then why are you here?
villagechatter.sabotage.piglin.done.0: §o*happy oink*§r You did it! Friend of the piglins.
villagechatter.configuration.feudGain.to: Killing one side's people gains this much with the other sides (piglin edges).
villagechatter.configuration.sabotageJob: Villagers, piglins and pillager captains offer sabotage jobs against each other.
villagechatter.configuration.sabotageRew: Standing gained when you report a sabotage job done.
villagechatter.configuration.sabotageDec: Standing lost when you turn a sabotage job down.
villagechatter.configuration.sabotageDay: Days a sabotage job stays open.
villagechatter.option.pillager_talk.0: What are you lot up to?
villagechatter.sabotage.pillager.raid.vi: %2$s. Soft walls, fat pantries. Ride with us: put down %1$s of them where my lads can see it, then come back for your cut.
We hit %2$s next. I want to see you bloody your hands: %1$s of them, golems count. My boys will be watching.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.0: Villagers. Bleating like sheep. I can't wait to shut them up.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.1: Another day, more blood on my blade.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.2: Keep walking. The captain does the talking.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.3: Ever hear a village bell ring at midnight? Best sound there is.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.4: Those farmers hide behind their iron giant. Giants fall.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.5: You're still breathing because the captain says so. Remember that.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.6: Whatcha gonna do? Huh? Whatcha gonna do?
villagechatter.pillager.bark.7: What're you looking at? Go find the captain.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.8: I've burned bigger villages than the one you came from.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.9: Hrm. You smell like a villager. Wash.
villagechatter.pillager.captain.talk.0: The villages think the night belongs to them. We remind them it doesn't.
villagechatter.pillager.captain.talk.1: Every outpost you see, we built from what we took. Nobody gives us anything.
villagechatter.pillager.captain.talk.2: The pig-men? Greedy, loud, and they'd sell their own mothers for a gold nugget. Don't trust them.
villagechatter.pillager.captain.talk.3: My lads follow the banner, not the man. Remember that if you ever want one of your own.
villagechatter.pillager.captain.talk.4: A ravager's worth ten golems. Fifteen if it's hungry.
villagechatter.pillager.captain.talk.5: You want to ride with us, you earn it. Blood first, talk after.
villagechatter.configuration.talkToPilla: Pillagers and vindicators who tolerate you can be talked to; captains give jobs.
villagechatter.configuration.raidRange.t: How far a pillager captain looks for a village to raid.
How close to the raided village a kill must be to count.
villagechatter.configuration.raidKillGai: Pillager standing per raid kill a pillager sees.
villagechatter.configuration.raidKillLos: Village standing lost per raid kill a pillager sees.
villagechatter.configuration.wipeoutLoss: Village standing lost when you wipe out a village yourself.
villagechatter.configuration.wipeoutMora: Gossip held against you by villagers near a village you wiped out.
villagechatter.configuration.wipeoutRadi: How far the news of a wiped-out village reaches.
villagechatter.standing.faction.disguise: Pillagers: they don't know you under that banner
villagechatter.configuration.bannerColou: An ominous shield, banner on your head, crested helmet or Curios head slot: outpost pillagers treat you as at least Tolerated.
villagechatter.configuration.bannerUnsee: Pillager standing lost when one sees you below Tolerated without their colours.
villagechatter.configuration.bannerVilla: Village standing lost when a villager sees you wearing the pillagers' colours.
villagechatter.configuration.bannerSight: Ticks before the same outpost, patrol or village can cost you again (24000 = a day).
villagechatter.configuration.heroAngersP: While you're a Hero of the Village, pillagers are hostile.
villagechatter.piglin.quest.gold.0: §o*snort*§r Gold. Bring us gold. %s ingots. Then you're a friend.
villagechatter.piglin.quest.gold.1: We want shiny. %s gold ingots, here, soon. §o*oink*§r
villagechatter.piglin.quest.heirloom.0: §o*grunt*§r A villager stole our golden thing. Up top, near where we stand, eight times far: a village, by %s, %s. It's in one of their boxes. Get it.
villagechatter.piglin.quest.heirloom.1: Our heirloom! Taken! §o*angry snort*§r The village above, around %s, %s. Look in their boxes. Bring it back... or keep it, thief.
villagechatter.piglin.quest.heirloom_nea: Something golden is hidden in one of this village's containers.
villagechatter.sabotage.piglin.gold_done: §o*happy oink*§r Shiny! All of it! Good, good.
villagechatter.sabotage.piglin.heirloom_: §o*squeal*§r You found it! The golden thing! Friend forever. Maybe.
Ours again! §o*happy grunt*§r Villagers are thieves. You are the good kind of thief.
villagechatter.configuration.piglinGoldQ: Piglin standing per gold ingot handed over for a gold quest.
villagechatter.configuration.piglinHeirl: Piglin standing for bringing back the heirloom.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.gear.0: %s? Now that's a gift. I'll put it to use on some farmer.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.gear.1: Ha! %s. Good steel. You might be all right.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.gear.2: %s. I'll wear it to the next raid and think of you.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.meat.0: Meat. Real food, not that bread the villagers live on.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.meat.1: %s? The lads will fight over it. Thanks.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.meat.2: Hm. %s. Fine. A man's got to eat between raids.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.sweet.0: Sweets? Do I look like a villager's brat to you?
villagechatter.pillager.gift.sweet.1: Take your candy and get out of my sight.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.sweet.2: Is this a joke? Keep it.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.reject.0: What would I want with that?
villagechatter.pillager.gift.reject.1: Bring me steel or meat. Not junk.
villagechatter.pillager.gift.too_many.0: Enough. You're starting to look desperate.
villagechatter.configuration.wrongGiftLo: Goodwill or standing lost for the wrong gift.
villagechatter.configuration.cookedGiftB: Cooked food as a gift is worth this many times raw food.
villagechatter.configuration.pillagerGif: Pillager standing for a gift of meat (gear counts half again).
villagechatter.greeting.entity.minecraft: §o*snort*§r Well, well. What's that you've got in your pocket?
Psst. §o*oink*§r Over here. You look like someone with things.
A pale one! §o*snort*§r What did you bring? Nothing? Everybody brings something.
§o*grunt*§r Don't mind me. Just standing here. Not looking at your bag.
Ooh, a visitor. §o*oink*§r Visitors always have the best pockets.
§o*snort*§r You lost? Lost things are finders' things, you know.
Shh. §o*grunt*§r Quiet now. What are you selling? What are you hiding?
§o*snort*§r I can smell it. Gold. Somewhere on you. Don't tell me where. I'll guess.
Oh, oh, oh. §o*oink*§r That glint. Is that for me? It looks like it's for me.
§o*grunt*§r Nice and shiny, you. Walk slower. Let me look.
Gold! §o*snort*§r We should be friends. Very close friends. Arm's-length friends.
§o*oink*§r My favourite pale one! Got anything shiny you don't need?
Ah, you! §o*snort*§r I kept a spot warm for you. Nobody saw. Good.
You again. §o*oink*§r The others say you're a fair one. I say you're a fair one with pockets.
§o*snort*§r You. I remember your face. And what you took.
Careful, pale one. §o*grunt*§r We count our gold twice when you're around.
Oh, it's YOU. §o*snort*§r Hands where I can see them.
villagechatter.smalltalk.entity.minecraf: Found a golden carrot once. §o*oink*§r Nobody asked where. Nobody needs to know.
The fortress ones keep their gold behind lava. §o*snort*§r Lava's just a long way round.
§o*grunt*§r Hoglins don't watch their stuff. That's why I'm fond of hoglins.
Your sky turns us all wrong, you know. §o*snort*§r Don't take us up there. Unless there's gold.
Ghasts cry all day. §o*oink*§r Cry and cry. Never once seen one hide anything, though. Useless.
What's mine is mine. What's yours... §o*snort*§r we'll talk about it.
§o*grunt*§r A chest is just a question. Gold is the answer.
villagechatter.farewell.entity.minecraft: §o*oink*§r Bring shiny next time. Lots. In your pockets. I'll check.
Off you go. §o*grunt*§r Mind your bag on the way out.
Bye, pale one. §o*snort*§r Nothing missing? Good. Good.
villagechatter.greeting.combat.4: I'm hiding! You never saw me!
villagechatter.smalltalk.combat.2: I can't think, I can't think!
villagechatter.smalltalk.combat.3: Is it over? Tell me it's over.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.combat.5: Good timing. Grab a blade and stand with me!
villagechatter.greeting.guard.combat.6: You there! Fight with us or get out of the way!
villagechatter.greeting.guard.betrayer.0: You wear their colours and walk in here mid-fight? Bold.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.betrayer.1: So that's whose side you're on. I'll remember your face.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.betrayer.2: You brought them here, didn't you? Traitor.
villagechatter.greeting.guard.betrayer.3: Turncoat! Stand aside before I put you down with the rest.
Not one more word from you, raider-friend.
Every house they burn is on you.
villagechatter.farewell.guard.betrayer.0: Run back to your crossbow friends.
villagechatter.farewell.guard.betrayer.1: Next time we meet, I won't be talking.
villagechatter.farewell.hurt.1: Don't fall over on the way, all right?
villagechatter.raid.praise.0: Ha! Did you see them run? You fight like one of us!
villagechatter.raid.praise.1: That's how it's done! Drinks are on the village, since it's ours now.
villagechatter.raid.praise.2: You stood with us when it counted. The captain heard. We all heard.
villagechatter.raid.praise.3: Look at that! Not one bell left ringing. Good work, friend.
villagechatter.raid.scorn.0: Where were you when the golem came? Hiding, I bet.
villagechatter.raid.scorn.1: Some ally. We bled for that village and you watched.
villagechatter.raid.scorn.2: Don't wear our colours if you won't fight under them.
villagechatter.raid.scorn.3: We lost good people back there. You didn't even get your boots dirty.
villagechatter.raid.gloat.0: Put it down. It's over. There's more of us than there'll ever be of you.
villagechatter.raid.gloat.1: Your village is ours. Stand down, and maybe you walk away from this.
villagechatter.raid.gloat.2: You fought well. Not well enough. Lay down your weapon.
villagechatter.raid.gloat.3: Look around you. Every one of them is mine. Choose carefully.
villagechatter.raid.taken.0: Smart. Now get out of my sight.
villagechatter.raid.taken.1: Call it a toll for walking out alive.
villagechatter.raid.taken.2: Good choice. You're free to crawl home.
villagechatter.raid.defied.1: Brave. Stupid, but brave. At them!
villagechatter.raid.defied.2: Then you die with your village.
villagechatter.configuration.raidOutcome: Pillagers praise or scorn you after a raid you sided with; if you fought them and lost, their captain makes you surrender or fight on.
Pillager standing gained when a raid you sided with is won.
Pillager standing lost when a raid you sided with is lost.
villagechatter.pillager.bark.10: We take what we want. Always have.
villagechatter.raid.gloat.4: Drop it. You lost. Kneel and you might keep your legs.
villagechatter.raid.praise.5: You swing a blade like you mean it. Stick around.
villagechatter.raid.taken.3: The ultimate insult is to be spared.
villagechatter.raid.taken.4: That, and your life. Don't make me regret the second one.
villagechatter.raid.taken.5: I'll let you live this time, cur!
villagechatter.raid.taken.6: Walk. And tell them who let you.
villagechatter.raid.taken.7: Keep your head down on the way out.
villagechatter.raid.taken.9: Run home. Tell them we were kind.
villagechatter.greeting.victory.2: Is it gone? It's gone. Ha!
villagechatter.greeting.victory.3: My knees are still shaking, but we're alive!
villagechatter.greeting.victory.4: Somebody tell the guards they did good.
villagechatter.law.bribe_ok.3: All right, all right. Just keep your voice down and don't let me catch you again.
villagechatter.law.bribe_ok.4: Pockets lighter, record cleaner. Go on.
villagechatter.law.paid.3: Good enough. I'll just confiscate any stolen goods you're carrying, then you're free to go.
villagechatter.law.paid.4: Paid in full. Don't give me a reason to remember your face.
villagechatter.raid.defied.4: Fight well, and I'll make sure your corpse is not dishonored.
villagechatter.raid.poor: Then your poverty is my reward. Kill or be killed!
villagechatter.kin.demand.0: You assaulted one of my family members. I have come to accept your apology.
villagechatter.kin.demand.1: You're the one who hit my sister. Don't pretend you aren't.
villagechatter.kin.demand.2: Hold it. You laid hands on my cousin. I think you owe us something.
villagechatter.kin.demand.3: My brother's still got the bruise. You and I need to talk.
villagechatter.kin.demand.4: You. Yes, you. You struck one of mine. Well?
villagechatter.kin.sorry.0: Stay away from my family if you value your life.
villagechatter.kin.sorry.1: Hmph. Words are cheap. Keep your hands to yourself.
villagechatter.kin.sorry.2: Fine. But I'll be watching you.
villagechatter.kin.sorry.3: I'll tell them you said so. Don't make a liar of me.
villagechatter.kin.sorry.4: That's all I wanted. Now go.
villagechatter.kin.insist.0: You say you're sorry. Say it now.
villagechatter.kin.insist.1: I'm not leaving until I hear it.
villagechatter.kin.insist.2: Think very carefully before you answer me again.
villagechatter.kin.insist.4: Do you want the whole village hearing about this?
villagechatter.kin.swing.1: Then here's something to remember us by!
villagechatter.gear.ask.0: That %s you got rid of. I can have it, yeah?
villagechatter.gear.ask.1: Oh! You dropped your %s. Mind if I keep it?
villagechatter.gear.ask.2: Are you throwing that %s away? I'd put it to good use.
villagechatter.gear.ask.3: Hey, that %s... nobody else is going to want it. Can I?
villagechatter.gear.ask.4: Psst. The %s on the ground. Is it free?
villagechatter.gear.thanks.0: That's mighty fine of you. Thank you.
villagechatter.gear.thanks.1: Really? Oh, wait until the others see!
villagechatter.gear.thanks.2: I'll take good care of it. Promise.
villagechatter.gear.thanks.3: You're too kind. Thank you, truly.
villagechatter.gear.shrug.0: Meh. I didn't want it anyway.
villagechatter.gear.shrug.4: Better pick it up before someone else does.
villagechatter.option.kin_apologise: I'm sorry. It won't happen again.
villagechatter.configuration.kinConfront: Hit a villager, and a while later one of their neighbours finds you and wants an apology.
villagechatter.configuration.friendlyFir: Hit a guard, your hired guard or an allied pillager, and the first hits are taken as accidents (with a warning). One more within a minute and they treat it as an attack.
villagechatter.configuration.friendlyHit: How many hits an ally forgives before turning on you.
villagechatter.configuration.brawlCheers: Villagers who see you in a fist fight (or fighting another player) in their village cheer it on.
Guards call the hour at dawn, noon, dusk and midnight, like a town watch.
villagechatter.configuration.gearRequest: Drop armor or a weapon near a villager, and they ask whether they can have it.
villagechatter.raid.demand.items.1: %s. Hand it over and walk away.
villagechatter.raid.demand.items.2: I'll take %s off you. Call it a toll.
villagechatter.raid.demand.armor.0: The clothes off your back. Your armor, all of it.
villagechatter.raid.demand.armor.1: Strip that armor. It's ours now.
villagechatter.raid.demand.weapon.1: I'll have that %s. You won't be needing it.
villagechatter.configuration.tollItemsWe: How often a captain demands 1-3 random things from your inventory when you surrender (a weight).
villagechatter.configuration.tollArmorWe: How often a captain demands the armor you're wearing when you surrender (a weight).
villagechatter.configuration.tollWeaponW: How often a captain demands the weapon in your hand when you surrender (a weight).
